name: FINAL WARS
about: The C example FINAL WARS rebuilt in blocks and taken deeper (PAD-658): a round of KING GHIDORAH, OXYGEN DESTROYER and MASER BARRAGE played (or two of them won) lights it at the Building the first time, two rounds the second, three the third. Four phases of 40 s each: save the cities (the ramps and the Big loop), hit the moving Monster X (the line names its target), break Keizer Ghidorah's three beams at the Maser target, the Godzilla target and the pop bumpers before Godzilla's power drains (the Mecha lane recharges it), and GODZILLA RISES, a 2-ball multiball with jackpots at the ramps and the Big loop and the Building super jackpot. A phase done within 20 s carries the multiplier up (to x4); shields add time.
lost: No randomness in blocks: Monster X moves to the next target in turn (Powerline left, center, right, the Godzilla target, round again) every 10 s and when hit, where the C picked another target at random every 3 s (2.3 s, 1.6 s on later starts).

Every phase has 40 s on every start and Godzilla's power drains one every 3 s (PAD-658's round 3: time to do it); the C gave each phase 25 s (20 s the last), 3 s shorter each start, and drained the power every 2 s (1.6 s, 1.2 s). A quick phase is one done within 20 s (the C: 10 s or more left of 25).
A new phase is named by the HUD's title (PHASE 2: MONSTER X ...), not by a note over the one the phase before ended on: that note (QUICK! MULTIPLIER UP, or what comes next) stays its 3 s.

The ledger is six shared variables (ghidorah / oxygen / maser played and won) the blocks KING GHIDORAH, OXYGEN DESTROYER and MASER BARRAGE set; the C modes' own ledger (kit_ledger) is a different store, so the C versions of those modes do not light this blocks version, nor the other way round.

A round counts on the next shot after it is played (blocks only look while a shot is made), where the C looked twice a second; and the FINAL WARS IS LIT note shows then, not 7 s after the other mode's total.
The lit Building pulses as any lit mode does (the runtime's light), where the C pulsed it only while none of our modes ran and not between balls.
The ending title (GODZILLA WINS or THE XILIENS WIN) and its total stay up 3 s, the runtime's: the C kept them 10 s, with FINAL WARS TOTAL under the total.
It plays its own light shows at every moment, where the C played the game's Strobe storm and Red and blue fade (its own shows only on a game without them).
Godzilla Pro 1.16 has two shields (no centre one, no platform to turn): its left and right add the time, where the C simply had one shield fewer there.

intro.what: Godzilla close-up at night: his dorsal plates and mouth light up blue as he charges his ray (one shot)

loop.what: New York at night: Rodan swoops past the Empire State Building and a full moon, glass shatters, ends on Rodan silhouetted against the moon

loop2.what: Dark blue ruined Tokyo: Godzilla faces Monster X, then a wide shot of the two fighting among burning ruins

loop3.what: Keizer Ghidorah towers over the dark smoking city, then its heads attack Godzilla

phase.what: Godzilla's ray erupts across the night city in a blue-white blast

won.what: Godzilla glows blue and fires his red spiral ray, a blazing column across the screen

lost.what: Keizer Ghidorah's golden gravity beams pour into Godzilla, draining him

keizer.what: Keizer Ghidorah's three heads rear up over the burning city, glow gold and fire their gravity beams into the sky (one shot), 1:50:49.

power.what: Ozaki's Kaiser power pours into Godzilla as a blue beam, then washes over his back in a cyan glow (a run of two shots), 1:53:12.

rises.what: Godzilla, shining pale blue with the new power, turns and roars at Keizer Ghidorah (one shot), 1:53:18.

jackpot.what: Godzilla seizes Keizer Ghidorah's head and blasts it point blank with his ray in a burst of sparks (a run of quick shots), 1:53:27.

super.what: Keizer Ghidorah bursts apart in red and gold fire, ending in a white-orange fireball (one shot), 1:54:41.

music.what: the end-title score (bed finder: final 0.895, the best of the eight films)

phase1.what: Godzilla roaring through the smoke in the city (the game's own 1954 roar matches 0.77; a harmonic roar)

won.what: Godzilla's roar after the battle (harmonic roar cpp 0.43, the strongest)

lost.what: Keizer Ghidorah's gravity beams striking (broadband onset at 1:51:39.0)

phase2.what: Keizer Ghidorah's three heads rising and roaring as Monster X becomes it

beam.what: Keizer Ghidorah's gravity beams crackling out of its three heads over the battle's score and din, 1:50:51.

jackpot.what: The blast of Godzilla's ray striking Keizer Ghidorah point blank, 1:53:30.

super.what: A heavy explosion rising out of the battle's din as Keizer Ghidorah is struck, 1:54:15.

rises.what: Keith Emerson's driving main title theme (audio only; the credits are on screen), 0:03:46 (bed finder: seam chroma 0.904, onset 0.39, untuned 0.04, no onsets or bursts, self-check pass).
